statements.statement: challenge = BASE64URL(SHA256(ASCII(verifier))), base64url without padding; the generator keeps the first n characters; 43 characters use exactly 32 random bytes (256 bits), the amount RFC 7636 7.1 recommends.
statements.qualification: bytesForLength(43)=32 and entropyBits(43)=256 (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:386-394); RFC 7636 4.1 NOTE (32 octets -> 43 chars) and 7.1 (minimum 256 bits).

statements.statement: Appendix B verifier dBjftJeZ... gives E9Melhoa2... and is the base64url form of the 32 octets starting 116, 24, 223, 180.
statements.qualification: Engine output equals the RFC value; test-pkce-generator.mjs:102-106 rebuilds it from the RFC octets.

statements.statement: Worked authorization URL with state=xyz and nonce=n-0S6_WzA2Mj; values are form-encoded (space becomes +); code_challenge_method is always written because a missing method means plain.
statements.qualification: buildAuthUrl uses URLSearchParams and deletes then appends each parameter (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:481-505); exact URL asserted at test-pkce-generator.mjs:196-197; RFC 6749 Appendix B, RFC 7636 4.3.

statements.statement: A standard-Base64 verifier stops with Character 13 "+" is not allowed..., followed by the base64url conversion hint; spaces, line breaks and non-ASCII text get their own hint; lengths outside 43-128 report the actual count.
statements.qualification: validateVerifier reports code point position and hint base64/space/nonascii (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:408-428); quoted text equals STRINGS.errChar at pos 13 (test asserts it).

statements.statement: The six-row diagnosis table (match, padding, standard Base64, hex, verifier itself, hash of decoded bytes) matches the checker; with plain selected the checker recognises the S256 value.
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge returns exactly those codes (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:449-471); every row is recomputed by test-pkce-generator.mjs:273-277.

statements.statement: The JavaScript, Python and Go functions all produce the RFC challenge and the tests run all three.
statements.qualification: test-pkce-generator.mjs:283-328 runs JavaScript always, Python and Go only when python3 / go are installed (SKIP otherwise, e.g. CI without Go).

statements.statement: golang.org/x/oauth2 also has GenerateVerifier, S256ChallengeOption and VerifierOption.
statements.qualification: pkg.go.dev v0.37.0 lists GenerateVerifier, S256ChallengeOption (AuthCodeURL) and VerifierOption (Exchange).

statements.statement: Competitor behaviour recorded 2026-10-01 (tonyxu, Ping, Elysia, AuthAction, Found Tools, encode64, ToolBada), including the SHA-256-of-nothing value for an empty field.
statements.qualification: Dated third-party observation; not re-run in this batch. The empty-field value 47DEQpj8... is confirmed as base64url(SHA-256("")) locally.

statements.statement: No upload or storage: getRandomValues and subtle in the tab, no network requests, no verifier in localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies/URL, no analytics or ad scripts, reload discards it.
statements.qualification: persistence.ts:14 is disabled; BaseLayout skips GA4/AdSense for sensitive pages (BaseLayout.astro:140,185); component has no fetch/storage/location (test static assertion).

statements.statement: 43 characters from 32 random bytes is the RFC 7636 4.1 / 7.1 recipe and gives 256 bits; up to 128 characters allowed; a pasted verifier must be 43-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~.
statements.qualification: MIN_LEN/MAX_LEN and UNRESERVED_CHAR (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:364-366, 425-427); RFC 7636 4.1, 7.1.

statements.statement: Use S256: RFC 7636 4.2 requires it when possible, RFC 9700 says S256 is currently the only method that does not expose the verifier, OAuth 2.1 removes plain, and LINE accepts only S256.
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1; draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-16 4.1.1 and 7.5.2 (plain removed and explicitly forbidden); LINE doc and LINE discovery code_challenge_methods_supported [S256].

statements.statement: Paste the sent code_challenge into the checker: it reports match, standard Base64, hex, padding, the verifier itself or a hash of the decoded bytes; if it matches, check that S256 was sent, the verifier is from the same login attempt and the code was used once.
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge codes and messages; RFC 7636 4.3 default plain; RFC 6749 4.1.2 single-use code.

statements.statement: RFC 9700 (2025) requires PKCE for public clients and recommends it for confidential clients because it also stops code injection; the cURL is public-client only, add client authentication yourself.
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1; buildCurl has no client_secret (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:514-528).

statements.statement: 计算式与 base64url 不带 =；生成器取 n 字节随机数编码后截取所需长度；43 个字符恰好 32 字节（256 位）。
statements.qualification: 同 en：bytesForLength / entropyBits / generateVerifier 的 slice。

statements.statement: 附录 B 的 verifier 得到 E9Melhoa2...；标准 Base64 写法会被第 13 个字符的提示挡住；空格、换行、中文各有提示，长度越界写出实际字符数。
statements.qualification: STRINGS.zh.errChar 与 hintBase64 / hintSpace / hintNonascii；测试比对 13 位。

statements.statement: 飞书获取授权码支持 PKCE，文档里 code_challenge 示例值即 E9Melhoa2...；code_challenge_method 可选 S256 / plain，不传默认 plain。
statements.qualification: Feishu obtain-oauth-code (fetched 2026-10-27): example value and "plain (Default Value)".

statements.statement: v3 端点 https://accounts.feishu.cn/oauth/v3/token 会拒绝「授权时未传 code_challenge、换 token 时传 code_verifier」，v2 不拒绝；错误码 20049 为 PKCE 校验失败。
statements.qualification: Feishu get-user-access-token (v2) migration notice and error table (fetched 2026-10-27).

statements.statement: 飞书请求示例的 verifier TxYmzM4... 在工具中得到 O0nS63zi...。
statements.qualification: Verifier text appears on the Feishu v2 token page; challenge recomputed locally (base64url SHA-256) and asserted by test-pkce-generator.mjs:96-97,166.

statements.statement: 微信网站应用登录的授权链接只有 appid / redirect_uri / response_type / scope / state，没有 PKCE 参数；换 access_token 要 AppSecret，只能在服务端完成。
statements.qualification: WeChat doc not fetched in this batch (fetch budget); statement unchanged from the 2026-10-01 review.

statements.statement: 五行判定表（末尾 =、标准 Base64、十六进制、verifier 本身、对解码字节哈希）与工具输出一致；最后一种在自写实现中常见；plain 下会提示发送 S256。
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge；表格逐行复算（test-pkce-generator.mjs:273-277）。

statements.statement: 三段代码都得到 E9Melhoa2...，本页测试会实际运行。
statements.qualification: JavaScript 总跑；Python / Go 只在解释器存在时执行，否则 SKIP。

statements.statement: Go 侧可用 golang.org/x/oauth2 的 GenerateVerifier、S256ChallengeOption（认证请求）与 VerifierOption（token 请求），结果相同。
statements.qualification: 原文称「飞书文档里的 Go 示例用的是 GenerateVerifier 与 S256ChallengeOption」；2026-10-27 抓取的飞书 v2 页面 Go 示例导入 golang.org/x/oauth2 并使用 math/rand，未见这两个 PKCE 调用，无法支持该句。改为对包的陈述，包 API 由 pkg.go.dev v0.37.0 证实。

statements.statement: 竞品观察（2026-10-01）：Elysia 上传、sosec.io 只报不匹配、authn.tech 无核对入口、tonyxu 不校验。
statements.qualification: 带日期的第三方观察，本批未复测。

statements.statement: 限制段：只有 S256 / plain；生成的 verifier 不出现 . 与 ~；熵只对生成的显示；不连授权服务器、cURL 按公开客户端；不检查平台规则；每次登录重新生成（RFC 9700 2.1.1）。
statements.qualification: 除「微信、Kakao 的 scope 用逗号分隔」外均由代码与 RFC 证实；逗号切分见 hasOpenid（PkceGeneratorTool.astro:473-476），上游文档本批未抓取。

statements.statement: 不上传、不保存：随机数来自 getRandomValues、SHA-256 来自 subtle；无网络请求；不写 localStorage / sessionStorage / Cookie / 网址；不加载统计与广告；刷新即丢弃。
statements.qualification: persistence disabled；BaseLayout 敏感页不加载 GA / AdSense；组件无存储与网络调用。

statements.statement: 默认 43 字符（32 字节、256 位），最长 128；手输 verifier 需 43-128 个 A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~。
statements.qualification: MIN_LEN / MAX_LEN / UNRESERVED_CHAR。

statements.statement: 选 S256：RFC 7636 4.2、RFC 9700、OAuth 2.1 草案去掉 plain；飞书不传 method 时按 plain。
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1；draft-16 4.1.1 / 7.5.2；Feishu obtain-oauth-code default plain。

statements.statement: 把实际发出的 code_challenge 贴进核对区；报出配对结果或常见错误；一致时再查 method、同一次登录、code 只用一次。
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge；RFC 7636 4.3；RFC 6749 4.1.2。

statements.statement: RFC 9700（2025）要求公开客户端用 PKCE、建议机密客户端用；机密客户端仍要客户端认证，cURL 需自行加凭据。
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1；buildCurl 无 client_secret。

statements.statement: PKCE の説明と計算式、43 文字＝32 バイト（256 ビット）、base64url に = を付けない。
statements.qualification: 同 en のコード根拠。

statements.statement: 付録 B の verifier から E9Melhoa2... が出る；標準 Base64 は 13 文字目のメッセージで止まる。
statements.qualification: STRINGS.ja.errChar と一致。

statements.statement: LINE ログインの PKCE は 4 手順、code_challenge は任意で未指定なら PKCE なし、code_challenge_method は S256 のみ、Yahoo! JAPAN アプリからの自動ログインが有効になる。
statements.qualification: LINE Developers「LINEログインをPKCE対応する」を 2026-10-27 に取得して確認（任意・S256 のみ・Yahoo! JAPAN の記述）。

statements.statement: LINE の discovery は code_challenge_methods_supported が ["S256"]。
statements.qualification: https://access.line.me/.well-known/openid-configuration を 2026-10-27 に取得。

statements.statement: LINE の例 wJKN8qz5... から BSCQwo_m8... が出る。
statements.qualification: Doc has the verifier; challenge recomputed and asserted (test-pkce-generator.mjs:94-95,165).

statements.statement: 5 行の判定表と、plain 選択時に S256 値を貼ると method を送るよう案内する挙動。
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge と cmpS256；表はテストで復算。

statements.statement: LINE のサンプルは Node.js の crypto.createHash('sha256') の Base64 から + / = を置換しており結果は同じ。
statements.qualification: Fetched LINE page shows exactly base64UrlEncode with those three replacements.

statements.statement: 3 つのコードが同じ値を返し、本ページのテストで実行する。
statements.qualification: Python / Go はツールチェーンがある場合のみ実行。

statements.statement: 競合の 2026-10-01 観察（Found Tools / encode64 の読み取り専用欄、Elysia の送信、tonyxu の無検証）。
statements.qualification: 日付付き観察、本批未再実行。

statements.statement: 制限段：S256 / plain のみ、生成値に . と ~ は出ない、エントロピー表示は生成値のみ、認可サーバーに接続しない、他社ルールは見ない、毎回作り直す。
statements.qualification: コードと RFC 7636 / 9700 に一致。

statements.statement: 送信・保存なし、乱数は getRandomValues、SHA-256 は subtle、通信なし、localStorage / sessionStorage / Cookie / URL に書かない、解析・広告スクリプトなし、再読み込みで消える。
statements.qualification: persistence disabled と sensitive レイアウト。

statements.statement: 既定 43 文字＝32 バイト（256 ビット）、128 文字まで、手入力は A〜Z a〜z 0〜9 - . _ ~ の 43〜128 文字。
statements.qualification: MIN_LEN / MAX_LEN / UNRESERVED_CHAR。

statements.statement: S256 を使う：RFC 7636 4.2、RFC 9700、OAuth 2.1 は plain 禁止、LINE ログインも S256 のみ。
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1、draft-16 7.5.2、LINE 文档。

statements.statement: 照合に貼ると一致か典型的な誤りかを判定；一致時の確認事項（method、同じ試行、code の単回使用）。
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge と RFC 7636 / 6749。

statements.statement: RFC 9700（2025）はパブリック必須・コンフィデンシャル推奨、cURL はパブリック向けで client_secret は自分で追加。
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1；buildCurl。

statements.statement: 계산식과 base64url 무패딩, 43자는 정확히 32바이트(256비트).
statements.qualification: 동일 코드 근거.

statements.statement: 부록 B verifier → E9Melhoa2..., 표준 Base64 표기는 13번째 문자 안내로 중단.
statements.qualification: STRINGS.ko.errChar와 일치.

statements.statement: 네이버 로그인 3.5절 OIDC PKCE: authorize/token 경로, scope=openid 필수, code_challenge_method 기본값 S256(RFC 4.3의 plain 기본과 다름).
statements.qualification: 두 엔드포인트는 2026-10-27 discovery로 확인(authorization_endpoint / token_endpoint). 기본값 S256은 2026-10-01 개발가이드 확인을 이어받았고 이번 예산에서 재조회하지 않음.

statements.statement: 카카오 discovery는 S256만 반환하지만 REST API 인가 코드 표에는 code_challenge가 없고(2026-10-01 확인), scope는 쉼표 구분이라 openid 인식 시 nonce가 붙는다.
statements.qualification: code_challenge_methods_supported [S256]는 2026-10-27 discovery로 확인. REST 표와 쉼표 구분은 2026-10-01 확인 / hasOpenid의 [\s,]+ 분리(473-476)에 근거하며 이번에 문서를 다시 받지 않음.

statements.statement: 5행 판정표와 plain 선택 시 S256 값에 method 안내.
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge / cmpS256, 표는 테스트에서 복산.

statements.statement: 세 코드가 같은 값을 반환하고 페이지 테스트가 실행한다.
statements.qualification: Python / Go는 도구 체인이 있을 때만 실행.

statements.statement: 경쟁 도구 2026-10-01 관찰(ToolBada / encode64, Elysia 전송, tonyxu 무검증).
statements.qualification: 날짜 있는 관찰, 이번 배치에서 재실행하지 않음.

statements.statement: 제한: S256 / plain만, 생성값에 . 과 ~ 없음, 엔트로피는 생성값만, 인가 서버 미연결, 제공자 규칙 미검사, 매 로그인 새로 생성.
statements.qualification: 코드와 RFC 7636 / 9700에 일치.

statements.statement: 전송·저장 없음, getRandomValues / subtle, 네트워크 요청 없음, localStorage / sessionStorage / 쿠키 / URL에 쓰지 않음, 분석·광고 스크립트 없음, 새로 고침 시 소멸.
statements.qualification: persistence disabled, sensitive 레이아웃.

statements.statement: 기본 43자(32바이트, 256비트), 128자까지, 직접 입력은 A–Z a–z 0–9 - . _ ~ 43~128자.
statements.qualification: MIN_LEN / MAX_LEN / UNRESERVED_CHAR.

statements.statement: S256 사용: RFC 7636 4.2, RFC 9700, OAuth 2.1 초안은 plain 금지, 네이버와 카카오 OIDC 메타데이터도 S256만 지원.
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1, draft-16 7.5.2, 그리고 2026-10-27에 받은 두 discovery(둘 다 code_challenge_methods_supported [S256]).

statements.statement: 대조에 붙여 짝 여부나 흔한 실수를 판정, 일치 시 method / 같은 시도 / code 1회 사용 확인.
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge, RFC 7636 4.3, RFC 6749 4.1.2.

statements.statement: RFC 9700(2025)은 퍼블릭 필수·컨피덴셜 권장, cURL은 퍼블릭 기준이라 client_secret을 직접 추가.
statements.qualification: RFC 9700 2.1.1, buildCurl.

statements.statement: Random values, SHA-256 and the URLs are computed in this tab; nothing is sent or saved; reloading discards the verifier (4 languages).
statements.qualification: Component has no fetch / storage / location calls; persistence disabled; the page still records the tool slug in the site-wide zt-recent list (ToolLayout.astro:353), which is not the verifier.

statements.statement: Generate creates a new verifier, state and nonce; Length takes whole numbers 43-128 and changing it regenerates; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter also generates; default 43 characters encode 32 random bytes.
statements.qualification: generate() sets verifier + 24-byte state/nonce (651-664); change handler (690-693); ToolLayout Ctrl+Enter clicks .tool-widget .btn-primary (360-367).

statements.statement: Paste 43-128 ASCII letters, digits or - . _ ~; surrounding whitespace is ignored; the challenge updates as you edit; Ctrl/Cmd+L clears the fields and results.
statements.qualification: trim + validateVerifier and input listener are exact. Ctrl/Cmd+L clears textarea and input[type=text] only (ToolLayout.astro:372), so Length (type=number) and the S256/plain choice stay, and the empty verifier then shows the paste-or-generate hint.

statements.statement: S256 hashes the verifier string with SHA-256 and encodes the digest as base64url without padding; plain uses the verifier unchanged.
statements.qualification: computeChallenge (PkceGeneratorTool.astro:441-445); RFC 7636 4.2.

statements.statement: Checking a pasted challenge identifies padding, standard Base64, hex and hashing decoded bytes instead of the verifier string.
statements.qualification: diagnoseChallenge codes padding / base64 / hex / rawBytes.

statements.statement: The endpoint must be http(s) without a fragment; parameters are URL-encoded, same-name parameters replaced; nonce only for the openid scope.
statements.qualification: buildAuthUrl (481-505); hasOpenid (473-476); RFC 6749 3.1 fragment rule.

statements.statement: The token preview builds a POST command with form-encoded fields and the verifier and does not send it; an empty code falls back to AUTHORIZATION_CODE.
statements.qualification: buildCurl (514-528) has no fetch; empty code default.

statements.statement: Copy buttons put the verifier, challenge, authorization URL or cURL on the clipboard.
statements.qualification: attachCopy returns silently when navigator.clipboard is absent and swallows writeText rejection (666-679); no execCommand fallback and no failure message, so on a non-secure context the click does nothing.
